general_exclusions: canonical prompt overlapping any fixed10k R/P/N prompt
references.general_teacher: pretrained W0 FP32 full-vocabulary log probabilities
references.general_positions: all true-target teacher-forced prediction positions; token mean then prompt mean
references.replay_loss: desired-new full-target NLL; token mean then prompt mean
references.replay_membership: latest committed occurrence per claim, excluding current-batch claims; no score-based filtering
references.replay_strata: sort latest occurrences oldest-to-newest; four contiguous quartiles; up to four per quartile, deterministic fill
references.empty_replay: zero; do not rescale general weight
references.rank_key: SHA256 compact UTF8 JSON [seed,batch_index,group,case_id], then integer case_id

main.start: each arm fresh W0/zero H4..8; no pilot state carry

execution.sample_order: unchanged canonical fixed10k list first2000; BS4 pilot first8; no shuffle; seal all IDs and20 batch boundaries
execution.original_inspect_script_scope: historical CPU evidence tests only B100x10; preserve bytes, extend task-local CPU checks to all20 before execution
execution.readonly_shared_assets: W0 model, C0, context strings, deterministic reference IDs and immutable W0 general teacher only; own-entry native teacher/K/P/h/H/R/gradient/decisions never shared

solver.algorithm: existing SPG/BB/block group-norm prox/line search; same settings and budgets for A/B
solver.plateau: six accepted points only; unchanged source policy
solver.fixed_budget_commit: fresh original materialized final evaluation of last accepted or initial; finite/feasible valid candidate commits regardless of convergence
solver.zero_entry_columns: entry NLL < .05 freezes corresponding R columns; still include their current NLL and native KL
solver.history: post ALL five actual writes, capture own post keys and append H once per layer, all request occurrences including zero-step/duplicate; next batch uses accumulated W/H
solver.source_binding: verify inherited executed implementation/settings; report conflicting source constant before changing it; no silent alternate solver

runtime.solver: existing SPG/BB/group-norm prox/line search; same settings across arms
runtime.direct_R_backward: common technical comparison before route freeze; preserve materialized forward and dX
runtime.route_selection: same route/microbatch for both arms, selected on fixed-candidate timing/memory and recorded numerical differences, not scientific arm outcomes
runtime.precision: FP32 weights/activation/R, FP64 geometry; TF32 off; preserve multiply-double -> cast FP32 -> add FP32
runtime.covariance: raw mom2 / positive actual mom2.count in FP32, then FP64; never raw sum
runtime.context_keys: group mean then group mean; canonical group .5, five remaining contexts .1 each
runtime.context_rewrite: six equal context means with complete target-token mean; current-request SUM
runtime.route_policy: fixed-candidate technical timing/memory only; finite differences record-only with original verdict, not arm efficacy selection. A/B identical route/MB.
runtime.dense_fallback: Do not prolong a new acceleration campaign. Unimplemented/incorrect direct-R route falls back to known materialized dense path within fixed budget; no hidden extra oracles.
runtime.reference_or_final_checks: All whole-batch original-route rechecks and final evaluation debit same science BudgetAccountant; final reserve1. No independent outer120 plus hidden internal calls.
runtime.microbatch: start qualified E123 MB4/reference route where implementation supports it; verify padding/all-token/cross-layer behavior; freeze safe common route/MB within shared technical6 budget
runtime.partial_graph_or_finite_rules: nonfinite trial can reject without mutation and halve step; corruption/CUDA error or initial/final nonfinite is fatal

policy.finite_numerical_difference: RECORD_ONLY_USER_DIRECTED: retain original thresholds, measured errors and original PASS/FAIL/WARN; do not relabel PASS or claim certification
policy.commit_weight_identity: bitwise with final original materialized candidate
policy.finite_nonconverged_candidate: fresh-evaluate last accepted or initial point; do not commit rejected trial
policy.trial_nonfinite: USER_APPROVED: reject non-mutating trial, halve step within existing call cap, retain last accepted; initial/final nonfinite/state corruption fatal
hard_structural_gates: committed five weights bitwise intended final candidate

cross_diagnostic.scope: fixed final all-five candidate at the same entry; virtual no-grad interventions, no commit or layer selection
cross_diagnostic.prompt_groups: up to four current, four relation-matched general reference, four past reference; canonical prompt and subject lookup; deterministic ID order
cross_diagnostic.quantity: d_joint - sum_l d_l at same input/subject L8 block output; absolute and relative norm, near-zero denominator marked NA

metrics.pilot_actual_denominators: R4/P8/N40 current, actual allseen prefix; never main denominators
metrics.preference: R/P new NLL < true NLL; N true NLL < new NLL; ties failure
additional: paired lost/gained with IDs and denominators
reference G KL and past E NLL separate from independent official RPN
per-layer R and actual D norm, ideal/actual write energy, active columns, clamp, residual, concentration
metrics.claims: Observed quality at equal calls/wall and comparable edit strength. Eta-different total objective not quality score. No hardware-mixed matched speed or causal claim.
metrics.evaluation_reuse: same endpoint+prompt/target/token/grouping/evaluator identity only; no approximate skip from similar scalar metrics

baselines.source_label_authority: GH adopts defaults in user handoff; not a claim user restated these names verbatim
baselines.order: Before new fit produce REUSE/EVAL_ONLY/RUN_MISSING/REFERENCE_ONLY matrix by endpoint, metric, source/hparams/context/token/model/order/precision/hardware.
baselines.reuse_condition: actual W20 after same first2000/BS100 and compatible canonical evaluation; W100 evaluated on first2000 is not W20; same scalar average is not identity.
baselines.missing_action: valid stored endpoint => missing observers only. No comparable result/endpoint => only missing baseline own W0/H0 BS100x20 on SH4; preserve native optimizer/stopping/history of named baseline.
baselines.comparisons: cross-host reusable quality explicitly labeled; paired raw required for lost/gained. Different BS/layers/precision/hparams is REFERENCE_ONLY for mismatched claim, not silently matched. Same-hardware time only.

resource.GPU_wall_policy: SH4 chooses finite wall from pilot/token work and actual partition, ceiling7days; not ETA/scientific budget. Record requested vs measured; no science call changes to fill wall.

CPU_collector.dependency: afterany all registered science/baseline jobs of this task

resource.actual_admission: include all existing allocated and independently admitted capacity; dependency/array throttle total<=2. If no free resource, legal pending graph; no unrelated cancellation.
resource.checkpoint_policy: no W/H/R/delta/optimizer or equivalent resumable bundles; exact_resume NOT_AVAILABLE. RAM transaction and compact identity/scalar raw allowed.
resource.storage: measure free/reserve; bound teacher/cache/FP64 solves/gradient/outputs before admission; no old waiver or deletion

lifecycle.DAG: CPU audit/source/input freeze -> shared prep+BS4x2 A/B pilot and shared <=6 B100 samecandidate -> both independent BS100x20 and only missing baselines -> CPU afterany report/manifest. Pre-register autonomous graph or equivalent persistent runners; no user/agent recall between stages.
lifecycle.technical_success_definition: structural finite feasibility/commit integrity; NOT low score/layer count/residual convergence/finite parity warning
lifecycle.initial_monitoring: bounded SH4 observe through actual representative MAIN B1 final commit +all5 history+observer restore+B2 own entry, not merely pilot PASS; then pause agent polling
lifecycle.resource_exception: if main graph all registered/inspected/released and verified resource shortage prevents starting, handoff pending and pause with initial NOT_OBSERVED; Reason=None/dependency/throttle alone not proof
lifecycle.natural_completion: registered runners/collector finish2k chains+comparison package. After initial pause no agent polling/heartbeat/auto-recall; detailed completion review at user recall unless everything ends before initial boundary.
lifecycle.technical_repair: reproducible implementation/serialization defect may be minimally repaired/new immutable attempt resubmitted within same scope; preserve failure/cost/no duplicate valid work. No scientific changes/threshold tuning/repeat-to-PASS.
lifecycle.current_other_tasks: unrelated jobs/sources/paused tasks unchanged; previous SH4 migration STOP does not block newly authorized independent task
